# PIA (Private AI Doc Analyzer)

PIA is a privacy-first document analysis product by Yups. Paste or upload a document, pick a workflow (Summarize, Review, Extract, Compare, Timeline, or Ask), and get structured results.

PIA does not store documents or prompts. Refreshing the page clears the working copy from the app.

## Standard vs Deep Analysis

- **Standard (Private Mode):** The model runs in your browser. No account required. Documents stay on your device. Free forever.
- **Deep Analysis:** Optional paid mode. The request is encrypted to the PIA API and processed by named privacy-constrained providers. PIA does not store documents or prompts. Plans start at €9/month.
